content: Hello, this is Amazon Customer Support. My name is Daniel and I'm reviewing your recent order status. Can I confirm you are speaking with Mr. Li?
Yes, I am Li. You are from Amazon?
Yes, Mr. Li, I'm the lead on refund processing. I noticed an unusual hold on your recent package from our international warehouse. I want to assist you to resolve this as soon as possible.
Oh, I did not get my package. It is stuck?
Correct, there's a regulatory flag on your account related to a new customs policy. Before discussing next steps, could you please confirm your full delivery address for verification?
My address is 44 Maple Drive, Lansing, Michigan.
Thank you, Mr. Li. Please also confirm the phone number on your Amazon account, just to complete our records.

Perfect. Now, regarding your package, Amazon has implemented a temporary customs compliance fee for certain imported items. This is a regulatory requirement and must be completed before your order or any refund is processed.
I do not understand. Why I need pay? I already pay for everything.

I completely understand your concern, Mr. Li. This is not a product charge, it's a refundable customs clearance fee imposed by international shipping laws. Once you pay it, we immediately release your package and refund the fee within 24 hours.
You promise I get it back? I do not want lose money.
Absolutely, sir. The amount is fully refundable and I will personally monitor your refund process. May I ask, do you have access to Amazon gift cards or a payment app like Zelle or CashApp?
I have Amazon gift card, but I not use Zelle before.

No problem, gift cards are acceptable. For the customs fee, the amount is $175. Could you please purchase an Amazon gift card in that amount and share the code with me here? I'll process it directly to customs.
I buy gift card at store? And then what I do?

Yes, please buy an Amazon gift card at any nearby retailer or online. Once you have the card, scratch off the protective strip and tell me the code printed on the back. I'll enter it into our customs clearing system.
I try, but I am not sure how. Is this safe? Amazon really do this?
I assure you, Mr. Li, this is a standard process for international shipments delayed by customs. Your account and funds are safe. I will stay with you through every step.
Okay, I will try to get the card after work. You wait?
Of course, I'll remain on your case file until the matter is resolved. When you have the code, please message me immediately and I will confirm with the customs department.
If I get the card, I tell you the numbers here? Is that all?
Yes, just the code on the back of the card. Once I receive it, I'll update your account and send you confirmation as well as your refund receipt.
I understand now. Thank you for helping me.
You're welcome, Mr. Li. Please let me know if you have difficulty or questions while obtaining the card. I am here to guide you at every stage.
Okay, thank you. I try after work and send you the numbers.
Thank you for your cooperation. Resolving this today will ensure your order is released without further delay.
